_comment: Labeled phrase corpus for Moss semantic retrieval. Two classes: 'recoupment' (payer is taking money back) and 'benign' (ordinary EOB adjustment language that must NOT be flagged). Classification is nearest-neighbour: an EOB line is flagged only when its top Moss hit is a 'recoupment' doc above the score threshold. Benign docs are load-bearing — they are what keeps contractual adjustments and patient-responsibility lines from firing. Approved human-review tickets are appended at runtime with id prefix 'learned-'.
